pages.text: Use it on a worker to put it on. Undead staff in one may work the Day shift and do not burn. Falling blocks do staff no harm. It never wears out.

Only a Hard Hat counts: Policy 4.1, hard hats, not helmets.$(br2)You may wear one too: a leather helmet's armour, and half the harm from falling blocks. It fits a Hat Mount.$(br2)$(o)Health and Safety thanks you.$()
